messages.subject: Re: IBM Watson Free Tier with R
messages.subject_clean: IBM Watson Free Tier with R
messages.body_plain:
For R in the cloud, I've been happy with cocalc.com <http://cocalc.com>
The free version is quite resource restricted, but there's a huge number of packages and
associated math programs installed, and the $80 year version has been just what I needed.

https://colab.research.google.com is python2/3 but I suspect they may add R eventually.
Notable for being backed by GPUs and their generous free level, which is lovely if
you're doing tensorflow.

Evelyn Mitchell

messages.subject: Some useful R functions you might not know (or have forgotten about)
messages.subject_clean: Some useful R functions you might not know (or have forgotten about)
messages.body_plain:
More cool R functions you might not know (or have forgotten about):
    janitor::get_dupes()
    xaringan:::inf_mr()
    rlist::list.filter()
    match.arg()
    readr's parse_number() and parse_time()
My full updated list at
https://www.computerworld.com/article/3184778/data-analytics/6-useful-r-functions-you-might-not-know.html

Sharon
